source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the receptors of taste (PDF 44).

blocks.text: Zaiqa khaas chemoreceptors, taste buds, mehsoos karte hain. Yeh taqreeban 10,000 hain, zyada tar zaban ke ubharon (papillae) ke darmiyan, kuch gale mein aur munh ki chhat par. Taste bud piyaz-numa hai, baal jaise siron wale receptor cells aur naye receptor cells banane wale basal cells se bana, aur taste pore se munh mein khulta hai.

Jab khane ya peene ki cheez ke kimiyai madde receptor cells ko jagate hain to woh sensory neurons mein impulses banate hain jo cranial nerves VII, IX aur X ke zariye brainstem aur phir cerebral cortex ke zaiqe wale hisson tak jate hain. Cortex ise boo aur banawat jaisi doosri maloomat ke saath mila kar zaiqe ka poora ehsas banata hai.

Kitab chaar qism ke taste buds batati hai, namkeen, meetha, khatta aur kadwa, jo zaban ke hisson mein ziyada hain: meetha nok par, khatta kinaron par, kadwa peeche aur namkeen zyada tar sateh par, kuch jagah aapas mein milte hue.

blocks.alt: Baen: zaban ki sateh mein laga piyaz-numa taste bud, lambe receptor cells jin ke baal jaise sire taste pore tak jate hain, neeche basal cells aur sensory nerve ke resha. Daen: haddi ki plate ke oopar olfactory bulb; olfactory neurons surmai supporting cells ke beech se haddi paar karte hain aur un ke cilia mucus ki teh mein hain jahan hawa ke boo wale molecules ghulte hain.
blocks.caption: Zaiqe ke receptors: taste bud (Figure 15.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Taste buds (taqreeban 10,000) chemoreceptors hain, zyada tar zaban ke papillae ke darmiyan; har aik taste pore se khulta aur us mein receptor cells aur unhein badalne wale basal cells hote hain. Khurak ke kimiyai madde receptor cells ko jagate aur impulses cranial nerves VII, IX aur X ke zariye brainstem aur phir cerebral cortex ke zaiqe wale hisson tak jate hain. Boo ke receptors nasal epithelium mein sensory neurons ke sire hain, supporting cells aur basal cells ke darmiyan; boo ke madde mucus mein ghul kar cilia se judte, aur impulses olfactory nerve (cranial nerve I) se olfactory bulb tak jate hain.

blocks.title: Matan ke baare mein
blocks.text: Zaiqe ke hisson wala 'zaban ka naqsha' ab purana samjha jata hai: zaban par har jagah ke taste buds har bunyadi zaiqe par jawab dete hain, sirf hasasiyat mein thora farq hota hai. Zyada tar kitabein paanchwan bunyadi zaiqa, umami (namkeen-gosht jaisa), bhi batati hain.

blocks.title: Aazma kar dekhiye
blocks.text: Boo zaiqe par asar karti hai: piyaz ka tukra pehle naak khuli rakh kar aur phir naak band kar ke khaiye aur farq dekhiye.

blocks.prompt: Kaunsi cranial nerves zaiqe ke impulses brainstem tak le jati hain?
blocks.explanation: Cranial nerves VII, IX aur X.

items: Taqreeban 10,000 taste buds (receptor cells, basal cells, taste pore); impulses nerves VII, IX, X se brainstem aur cortex tak; boo zaiqe mein izafa karti hai.
